subject: Joint livestream: Field Launch + Inference Ops — next steps
messages:
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Gomez <sara@nebulaops.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint livestream: Field Launch + Inference Ops — intro and proposal

Hi Sara —

Great to meet you at CloudSpring. We loved your talk about incremental rollout patterns for model updates — we think there’s a nice joint story between Redwood’s inference serving controls and NebulaOps’ release automation that would land well for our shared customer base.

High-level idea: a 45-min livestream (panel + 10–15 min demo) titled “Field Launches at Scale: Safe, Fast, and Cost-aware LLM Rollouts.” Goal is demand gen + capture product-led leads (trial signups) and an invite list made from both SDR lists.

Proposed dates: week of June 21 or June 28 (we’re flexible).

Attached: very short SOW sketch and a starter run-of-show. Can you confirm:
- Interest? (yes/no)
- Prefered date window?
- Who from your org would present / own logistics on your side?

If yes, I’ll loop in Marissa for commercial/partnership ops and Soojin for marketing amplification.

Thanks — looking forward to pairing on this.

— Priyom
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_NebulaOps_Livestream_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB), livestream-run-of-show_v1.docx (docx, 28KB)

From: Sara Gomez <sara@nebulaops.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Horvath <tom@nebulaops.com>, marketing@nebulaops.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint livestream: Field Launch + Inference Ops — intro and proposal

Hi Priyom —

Thanks — we’re definitely interested. This is very much aligned to a campaign we’ve been planning around our new release guardrails. June 28 works best for us (gives our product team time to prepare).

Tentative presenters: myself (product lead), Tom (field engineering), and one customer for a short case snippet — I’ll check availability. I’ve looped our marketing alias to coordinate comms.

Can you share what you need from us by next Wednesday (May 18)?

Best,
Sara
Director, Product Marketing
NebulaOps

Thanks Sara — great, we’ll lock June 28 for now and convert to a calendar invite when presenters are confirmed. Quick list of what we need from NebulaOps by EOD Wed May 18:

- Speaker names, titles, and short bios (one paragraph each) — CSV or Google sheet is fine (I attached a speaker-asksheet).
- Preferred demo scope for the 10–15 min segment (Karthik, our engineer, will coordinate).
- Logo in SVG and PNG for co-branded promo.
- Any compliance/security language you need included in the registration page.

On Redwood side: Marissa will handle partner contracting and SOW sign; Soojin will run the marketing calendar and social assets; Karthik will own the demo environment and staging link.

Attached: speaker-asksheet.csv, updated run-of-show (livestream-run-of-show_v2).

Action items:
- Sara: speaker bios + demo scope + logo by 2027-05-18
- Priyom: send calendar hold for June 28 and draft registration page
- Marissa: prepare SOW for signature

— Priyom

Subject: Re: Joint livestream: marketing cadence + amplification plan

Looping in the wider comms team — thanks for driving this, Priyom. High-level amplification plan:

- T-minus 3 weeks: co-branded save-the-date email to joint lists (we can split sends to minimize overlap).
- T-minus 7 days: pressy blog draft + partner quote (we’ll send a suggested quote to Sara).
- Live: coordinated social push (X, LinkedIn), paid promotion for a targeted ABM list (if partner agrees).
- Post-live: on-demand landing page + gated recording, nurture flow for attendees.

Marketing asks (due May 18): speaker bios, 2–3 quote lines from each presenter, logos and org descriptions. I’ll assign Emily to own creative and shared Drive folder.

— Soojin
Director, Demand Gen
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 09:40 AM Sara Gomez <sara@nebulaops.com> wrote:
> Tentative presenters: myself (product lead), Tom (field engineering)...

Thanks — quick tech notes from the demo side:
- We’ll want 10–15 mins for a live demo. Recommended flow: 5 min customer context, 6–8 min joint demo (Redwood + NebulaOps), 2–3 min Q&A handoff.
- Please provide a short demo checklist: sample dataset (<10MB), an inference config snapshot (model name + sequence length), and whether we should use Redwood hosted demo account or your staging (we can support both).
- I’ll need staging SSH/token access by June 18 if we’re doing on-prem connectors. If NebulaOps prefers to run the demo on their cloud, confirm the runtime plan (container image + endpoint).

I’ll set up a test call with your engineer (Tom?) next week to validate the flow.

— Karthik
Senior Field Engineer
Redwood Inference
